title: residual Mirror-MoE
hypothesis: A small per-role output residual added to a shared nonlinear expert with Mirror input/output views can recover aligned expert behavior more accurately than either Mirror-only sharing or an equally small residual on a hard-tied expert, while using far fewer actual bytes than independent experts.
physical_object: one 16x32x16 GELU expert (input and output matrices)
mirror_coordinate: per-role 2D Givens input and output angles
logical_multiplicity: four balanced oracle-routed nonlinear expert functions
controls: hard-tied expert plus per-role rank-1 output residual
hard-tied expert plus per-role rank-2 output residual
shared Mirror expert with no private residual
shared Mirror expert plus per-role rank-1 output residual
shared Mirror expert plus per-role rank-2 output residual

task.routing: balanced oracle top-1 labels supplied to all methods; router learning excluded

teacher_modes.aligned_private_rank1: one shared frozen MLP under per-role 2D input/output Givens views plus per-role rank-1 output residuals
teacher_modes.independent: four independently sampled full MLP experts

task.structure_audit: per-role MSE and role accuracy under supplied routes

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across all methods and teacher modes; choose LR, then Mirror private rank by aligned held-out MSE (rank-1 wins ties)

fresh.access_condition: At selected LR, the development-selected Mirror residual rank must achieve aligned MSE <=1.25x independent and payload <=0.80x independent; otherwise leave fresh sealed.

storage.serialization: torch.save CPU state_dict plus deterministic compact JSON config

success_gate: All three fresh aligned worlds: selected Mirror-residual rank MSE <=1.10x full independent, payload <=0.75x independent, and at least 10% lower MSE than the matched-rank hard-tied residual control at <=10% additional bytes. Report independent-teacher quality as the private-function boundary.
failure_gate: Development access gate misses; or in at least two fresh aligned worlds selected Mirror misses quality/bytes; or matched-rank hard-tied residual matches Mirror within 10% MSE at equal/lower payload in at least two worlds.
boundaries: teacher deliberately contains Mirror-aligned shared function plus rank-1 private output component
one hidden width and four experts
